scope: Automated battle decisions in Adventure, Rift and Colosseum; no combat engine legality or human action changes
changes: Shared status-effect pruning: weather/terrain, screens, capped hazards/stages, existing Encore/Disable, persistent flags, pending Wish, clone, statuses and pointless Haze.
Reconsider effects after expiration; allow room cancellation, slower first Encore/Disable, partial stat boosts and anticipatory recovery or clone renewal when public incoming damage warrants it.

Bounded completed-action Sucker Punch failure history per attacker and target, recent opposing move weighting up to 85%, risk-weighted penalty; retain legal forced moves, priority finishes and damaging alternatives.
Advanced trainer planning retains legal opposing hypotheses including full-HP recovery. No pending command, private opponent item/PP/IV/EV or random outcome inspected.
Simple wild/automatic selectors and legacy Colosseum tiers avoid active effects and prefer alternatives after an unproductive Sucker Punch when available.
Public snapshots expose effect presence, not the random remaining confusion/infatuation duration; completed memory and committed choice survive checkpoints.

fixtureRepairs: Wanda integration expected Starmie (121) instead of obsolete Tentacruel (73), matching the already deployed team; NPC data untouched.
Map-weather test now extracts existing applyFieldState and updateFieldState, and verifies deferred updates and clearing dry weather; frontend source untouched.
commands: node --test tests/ai-redundancy.test.js tests/human-trainer*.test.js tests/move-selection.test.js tests/colosseum-ai.test.js tests/*-tactics.test.js tests/sucker-punch.test.js tests/battle-field.test.js tests/map-weather.test.js tests/battle-order.test.js tests/battle-party.test.js

RUN_MYSQL_TESTS=1 DB_TEST_NAME=explorakit_test DB_NAME=explorakit_test node --env-file=.env --test --test-name-pattern='AI active weather Adventure|Coup Bas IA Aventure|Human AI commits|Human AI Adventure|Human AI finishing pressure|Mounir Aventure|Hoze Aventure|Raphael Aventure|Ana Aventure|Wanda Aventure' tests/battle-runtime-integration.test.js
limitations: Targeted regression suite, not every possible state of every Pokemon or a full project suite.
Chromium mobile emulation, no physical phone validation or visual redesign.
Representative six-versus-six planning timings, not a production load test or a global speedup claim.
A sole legal or forced move may still repeat; no free Struggle granted when legal PP remain.
